4186-8174.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enter, Mabel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.

728-3169-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3169-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-2113-3249-4242.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-4242.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

Activate Dromar's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Dromar's Attendant dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Dromar's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Dromar's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Dromar's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Dromar's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

1170-3446-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-4779-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

2738-3220-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Golgari Germination, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3259-5982-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-4188-7296.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

567-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

153-1270-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
You have at least two cards in hand.
153-1270-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Jolrael
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers three times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first and second Springheart Nantuko triggers, choosing not to pay and creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the third Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1558-3257-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3257-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

You have a land card in hand.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1174-3573-3869.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {G}.
1174-3573-3869.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
1174-3573-3869.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate a land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning the land that taps for {G} from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Gretchen by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card and put the land from step 3 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

When the creature tokens die, Wayward Disciple triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.

Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{R}.

Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Village Bell-Ringer from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
